messages.context: 第一次互动,第一句,欢迎语
messages.text: You're a long way from home!
messages.zh: 你在离家很远的地方啊!

messages.text: Luckily your coins are safe with me! Store them here before venturing deep into the depths of the Dwarven Mines!
messages.zh: 幸运的是,你的硬币在我这里很安全! 在深入矮人矿山之前,先把它们存在这里吧!
messages.raw: §fLuckily your §6coins §fare safe with me! Store them here before venturing deep into the depths of the §2Dwarven Mines§f!

messages.context: 闲置台词(条件未知),抱怨工作环境孤独
messages.text: Standing in that bank all day. Just me and the dwarves. But they are either all business, or drunk. Or both! I need better company!
messages.zh: 整天站在银行里。只有我和这些矮人。可他们不是在忙生意,就是喝得醉醺醺的。有时候两样都占! 我需要更好的伙伴!
messages.raw: §fStanding in that bank all day. Just me and the dwarves. But they are either all business, or drunk. Or both! I need better company!

messages.context: 闲置台词,推测和宠物/生物命名相关
messages.text: Oh what a lovely specimen this is. I wonder, how should I name you?
messages.gloss: 上下文不明确(采集来源标注为 'Completing' 状态但内容和银行业务无关,疑似模板复用,需要核实实际触发场景)。
messages.zh: 哦,多可爱的一个家伙啊。我该给你取个什么名字呢?
messages.raw: §fOh what a lovely specimen this is. I wonder, how should I name you?

messages.context: 闲置台词,吐槽矮人打嗝
messages.text: Well, maybe I will be able to understand the burping dwarves if I try hard enough.
messages.gloss: 呼应矮人矿山里几个'打嗝'酒馆 NPC(Gimley/Hornum/Sargwyn/Tarwen)的设定。
messages.zh: 唉,也许只要我够努力,总有一天能听懂这些打嗝的矮人在说什么吧。
messages.raw: §fWell, maybe I will be able to understand the burping dwarves if I try hard enough.
